comments.author: Oryzaki
comments.body_html:
The file SPT/user/mods/Tavor_X95/src/Mass_ModApi.js contains absolute paths starting at line 10. These types of absolute paths should not be used as they cause the mod to fail when run on non-Windows OSs. For anyone else encountering this issue simple remove the “C:” from the path.

Otherwise this is a great mod, thanks.
